locations.note: Eivor's homeland in Rygjafylke, the Viking Age name for Rogaland, where the story begins before the clan sails for England.
Viking Eivor raids and builds alliances across the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms of 9th-century England.
Hordafylke, today's Hordaland, is the second Norwegian region, opened later in the game.
Lunden, the Roman-walled London, is one of the three cities Eivor can explore.
Jorvik: Eivor spends Yule in the Viking city hunting the Order's agents among its merchants.
Alfred's capital, where Eivor roots out the Order inside the royal court and the cathedral.
Wrath of the Druids takes Eivor to Dublin in 879.
The Siege of Paris expansion raids Francia in 885.
Melun is one of the Frankish towns in The Siege of Paris.
Vinland: Eivor sails to the Norse foothold in Newfoundland.

routes.name: Eivor Varinsdottir
routes.note: Eivor's clan leaves the feuding fjords of Rygjafylke and sails west to carve out a settlement in Anglo-Saxon England.
